preconditions.description: The number of groups n must be between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 2 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each group size a_i must be either 1 or 2.

postconditions.expression: stdout.isdigit() and 0 <= int(stdout) <= (sum(int(x) for x in stdin.split()[1:]) // 3)
postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the maximum number of teams of three people that can be formed, not exceeding the total possible teams from the total number of students.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout) == max(teams for teams in possible_teams(stdin))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of teams of three people, where each team is formed by either: (1) three single students, or (2) one group of two students and one single student, ensuring both students from a group of two are in the same team if used.
